summary: Shows that a when on include_tasks is evaluated only at include time, so all included tasks run. Conditions on import_playbook produce repetitive skipped output; group_by is often cleaner.
questions: How do I apply a condition once to an included task file?
Can I put a when on import_playbook?
Is there a cleaner alternative to conditional imports for OS differences?

answer_card.title: Using include_tasks for a one-time condition
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- include_tasks: other_tasks.yml
  when: x is not defined
```

The condition is evaluated at include time only, so the included tasks all run.

You can also put conditions on `import_playbook` and other `import_*` statements, but you'll get a "skipped" message for every task on every non-matching host. The `group_by` module is often cleaner.
